query: What stakeholder validation approach (numbers/types of clinicians, patients; Delphi or focus group rounds) will we use to vet the coding taxonomy, and what dissemination products will we produce for implementers?

response.query: What stakeholder validation approach (numbers/types of clinicians, patients; Delphi or focus group rounds) will we use to vet the coding taxonomy, and what dissemination products will we produce for implementers?
response.answer: We will use a Delphi method with 10 clinicians and 15 patients for stakeholder validation. Dissemination products will include a user manual and online training modules for implementers.
